counting_rule: Count each recent scientific comparison/protocol once, including its seeds, folds, controls and retries. Feasibility studies, historical log entries, historical workflow groups and unrun proposals are separate categories; do not sum them as independent completed classification experiments.
layout: Per-study folders contain README.md and FILES.html indexes with relative links to canonical files. Original storage paths remain intact. The Windows-backed filesystem does not support symlink creation.

entries.title: Patient-grouped VMD versus WST with VQC
entries.description: Corrected comparison on verified patient folds, including all three VQC seeds and classical controls. The earlier row-grouped comparisons are historical.

entries.title: Matched KNN control and VQC training-fit diagnostic
entries.description: A separate fixed KNN diagnostic using the saved patient folds and VQC preprocessing. All 12 configurations are retained; previously fitted VQCs are reused, not counted as new fits.

entries.title: Nested VQC architecture and training improvement
entries.description: Completed nested candidate selection with compact circuits, repeated encoding, richer readout and epoch selection. The report retains the negative result and all seeds.

entries.title: LFCC and temporal Swin baseline
entries.description: The completed ECGData LFCC/Swin baseline and logistic control. The walkthrough and Colab reproduction are supporting material for this study, not additional completed studies.

entries.title: Thirty-second EMD/Hilbert morphology classifiers
entries.description: Completed v3 extraction and patient-separated logistic/SVC comparison. Interrupted v1 and v2 extraction attempts belong to this study and remain accessible. Its window length differs from the LFCC studies.

entries.title: LFCC/Swin epoch selection and dropout
entries.description: Completed 90 inner fits and 30 outer trials, with all three seeds. The primary selected procedure and the fixed dropout arm are reported separately. This is not a larger-model or raw-waveform experiment.

entries.title: ACS/OMI VMD versus WST with VQC and classical controls
entries.description: Completed original development comparison. CPU/GPU extraction attempts, convergence retries, benchmarks and the failed first workflow are supporting runs within this study. Official test patients remain reserved.

entries.title: Balanced OMI training and LFCC/Swin comparison
entries.description: Completed balanced VMD/WST VQC and classical fits plus LFCC/Swin and logistic fits. The original user-named workspace is preserved because its scripts and manifests depend on that path.

entries.title: OMI sensitivity thresholds and calibration
entries.description: The saved-score analysis and 14 new patient-separated calibration fits are two parts of one protocol. All targets and seeds are retained. The dedicated original study folder remains canonical.

entries.title: All-lead EMD/Hilbert feasibility pilot
entries.description: The engineering assessment completed but failed its declared gate. No classifier was trained. The initial and 16k failed attempts, 64k assessment, and stopping diagnostics are one pilot family.

entries.title: Lead-I EMD/Hilbert feasibility pilot
entries.description: A separate prospective Lead-I study. Its 512-record engineering check failed the extraction-coverage gate and stopped before classifier training.
